scope: Starter clean-export contamination classification, installed-runtime tolerance, bounded starter smoke-copy cleanup, provider-specific entry contract rejection, secret rejection, and sensitive-evidence contamination behavior.

checklist.clean_export_rejects_sensitive_evidence: pass: representative sensitive-evidence artifacts are rejected with a blocking sensitive_evidence diagnostic, including non-source .py artifacts.
checklist.secret_rejection: pass: common secret filenames and bounded text/config/doc content scans reject equals, quoted JSON/YAML colon, quoted Authorization Bearer, and fine-grained GitHub token forms without flagging normal policy identifiers that merely begin with a secret-like prefix.
checklist.oversized_secret_content: pass: oversized scan-eligible text/config/doc files fail closed as secrets rather than bypassing content scanning.
checklist.generated_report_and_log_rejection: pass: generated validation reports named with hyphens or underscores and root logs directory contents are rejected in clean-export mode.
checklist.root_harness_residue: pass: generic root .harness residue is rejected as a development artifact in clean-export mode, while installed-runtime tolerates approved .harness/state runtime residue only outside clean-export proof.
checklist.relative_path_classification: pass: clean-export classification uses starter-relative paths, preventing false positives from parent directory names such as secret-project or logs.
checklist.installed_runtime_boundary: pass: installed-runtime validation remains explicitly labeled not clean-export proof and tolerates approved generated runtime state only in installed-runtime mode.
checklist.smoke_copy_cleanup: pass: successful clean-export smoke copy was deleted, unmanaged directories are not deleted, preserved managed workspaces are pruned to one retained copy, and the current preserved workspace is never deleted by pruning.
checklist.path_safety: pass: cleanup refuses paths outside the configured smoke temp root and refuses unmanaged directories inside the root.
checklist.dependency_supply_chain: pass: no third-party dependency was added, removed, upgraded, or vendored.
checklist.generated_state: pass: generated runtime summaries were not manually edited as part of PKT-04B implementation.

residual_risk: Low residual risk after RED/GREEN fixture, independent-review remediation, expanded secret-content and generated/log artifact coverage, oversized scan-eligible fail-closed behavior, full starter regression, filtered clean-candidate smoke validation, root regression, and root validation.
